notes: The first prompt stopped after reading two files and building the login shell; a second prompt was needed to get the whole dashboard. Once it ran, the result is the most complete of the three: login with a real error message, 20 seeded bookings, search, working status filter, detail route per booking, CSV export and an empty state. The one broken promise is the editable field: Save notes looks like it works but nothing is written. Publishing is a separate click and free.
